item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 09/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to the south China coast in the next few days. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the region towards the weekend. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China early next week.

Date/Month: 10/11 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine.
Temp range: 22 - 27 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
